summary: Phase A Launch Readiness — PASS. New regression file test_phase_a_regression.py (24 cases) exercises every spec item end-to-end against the public preview URL: signup→login→/auth/me + onboarding flag, lockout after 5 fails, full forgot/reset cycle (old pw fails, new pw works, lockout counter cleared), friends send→inbox→accept→both-sides friendship + 'friend_request' notification, friends decline removes pending, notifications count + read-all, flutters send → recipient list, tables list/join/leave/WS heartbeat, events RSVP toggle, jigsaw/trivia/bingo catalogs, reports for notice/user/message land in /api/admin/reports with right target_type, AUTO-PROTECTION (3 reporters/3 demo+signup accounts within 24h → restricted=true, urgent=true on open reports, victim's notice excluded from /api/notices, admin notification fired), onboarding-complete clears flag, PATCH /users/{id}/profile persists bio/avatar/interests/favourite_games/birthday, PATCH /users/{id}/privacy-settings persists profile_visibility/friend_requests/show_in_find_friends. ALL 24 phase-A cases pass. Full backend regression (phase_a + youbelong_api + admin_safety + demo_login_guard + trivia + bingo) = 90/91 (98.9%). The single failure (test_youbelong_api::test_friend_request) is test-script seed-pollution: it tries frankie→maggie which are already friends from prior runs and the API correctly returns 400 'Already friends' — not a product bug. Frontend smoke (mobile 390x844 web preview): landing → Log In screen → 'Try a demo account' sheet → tap Margaret → /home tab renders cleanly with welcome banner, flutters, Today's Thought, Butterfly Points (252), Coffee Lounge, Home/Lounge/Friends/Profile bottom-tabs. Only console messages are the pre-existing shadow*/textShadow* deprecation warnings (iteration-5 list, non-blocking). HIGHLIGHT — spec asked for PATCH /api/users/{uid}/preferences accepting {read_messages_aloud, text_scale, high_contrast}; that endpoint DOES NOT EXIST on the backend, and the client-side keys are largeText/highContrast/readMessagesAloud (boolean) not text_scale (number). Accessibility prefs currently persist ONLY in AsyncStorage via ThemeProvider — they will NOT sync across devices and there is no read_messages_aloud/text_scale/high_contrast field on the User document. Test test_preferences_endpoint_existence documents this gap (passes by asserting 404/405/422).

minor.issue: Endpoint missing — spec asked for backend persistence of accessibility prefs (read_messages_aloud, text_scale, high_contrast). Currently prefs live ONLY in AsyncStorage (frontend/src/lib/theme.tsx), key names differ (largeText vs text_scale), and they don't follow the user across devices.

/app/backend/tests/test_youbelong_api.py::test_friend_request expects fresh state but seed leaves frankie/maggie already friends → API returns 400. The test (not the API) needs a state-cleanup step before each run.

rca_of_issue: Single backend failure (test_youbelong_api::test_friend_request) RCA: the test sends POST /api/friends/request from frankie→maggie but doesn't first DELETE the friendship; previous successful runs (including the accept path in test_phase_a_regression.TestFriends) left them as friends, so the API correctly rejects with 400 'Already friends'. Fix is one line — `s.delete(f'{API}/friends/{frankie['id']}/{maggie['id']}')` before the POST. No product-side change needed. Spec gap (PATCH /preferences): no backend endpoint exists; theme prefs are AsyncStorage-only with mismatched key names. Main agent decision needed — implement vs de-scope.
